'''Listfickmossa''' (''Fissidens bryoides'')<ref name = "C133"/><ref name = "C134"/><ref name = "C135"/><ref name = "C136"/><ref name = "C137"/><ref name = "C138"/><ref name = "C139"/><ref name = "C1310"/><ref name = "C1311"/><ref name = "C1312"/><ref name = "C1313"/><ref name = "C1314"/><ref name = "C1315"/><ref name = "C1316"/><ref name = "C1317"/><ref name = "C1318"/><ref name = "C1319"/><ref name = "C1320"/><ref name = "C1321"/><ref name = "C1322"/><ref name = "C1323"/><ref name = "C1324"/><ref name = "C1325"/><ref name = "C1326"/><ref name = "C1327"/><ref name = "C1328"/><ref name = "C1329"/><ref name = "C1330"/><ref name = "C1331"/><ref name = "C1332"/><ref name = "C1333"/><ref name = "C1334"/><ref name = "C1335"/><ref name = "C1336"/><ref name = "C1337"/><ref name = "C1338"/><ref name = "C1339"/><ref name = "C1340"/><ref name = "C1341"/><ref name = "C1342"/><ref name = "C1343"/><ref name = "C1344"/><ref name = "C1345"/><ref name = "C1346"/><ref name = "C1347"/><ref name = "C1348"/><ref name = "C1349"/><ref name = "C1350"/><ref name = "C1351"/><ref name = "C1352"/><ref name = "C1353"/><ref name = "C1354"/><ref name = "C1355"/><ref name = "C1356"/> är en [[bladmossor|bladmoss]]art som beskrevs av Hedwig 1801. Listfickmossa ingår i [[släkte]]t [[Fissidens|fickmossor]], och [[familj (biologi)|familjen]] [[Fissidentaceae]].<ref name = "COL"/><ref name = "source"/><ref name = "dyn"/> Enligt den finländska [[rödlistning|rödlistan]]<ref name = "redfi"/> är arten otillräckligt studerad i [[Finland]]. Arten är [[fortplantning|reproducerande]] i [[Sverige]].<ref name = "dyn"/> Artens [[livsmiljö]] är [[lundskog|friska och torra lundar]]<!--Mlt-->.<ref name = "redfi"/> Inga underarter finns listade i [[Catalogue of Life]].<ref name = "COL"/>
